entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The usual crowd of protesters was w..."
entries.dialogueText: The usual crowd of protesters was waiting for me outside the gates of the complex.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards formed a cordon to let m..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards formed a cordon to let me through.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I regarded them with suspicion as I..."
entries.dialogueText: I regarded them with suspicion as I passed. With the military against me, could they be trusted?
entries.menuText: Give the guards a suspicious look.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I rushed past the guards to my door..."
entries.dialogueText: I rushed past the guards to my door.
entries.menuText: Don't look at them and go to your door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hurried past them, went inside an..."
entries.dialogueText: I hurried past them, went inside and locked the front door behind me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once inside, I locked the front doo..."
entries.dialogueText: Once inside, I locked the front door behind me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't know if it was my imaginat..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't know if it was my imagination, but there seemed to be more guards outside my complex than usual.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I grabbed a beer from the fridge, w..."
entries.dialogueText: I grabbed a beer from the fridge, went to the living room and turned on the TV.
entries.menuText: Get a beer from the fridge.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went to the living room and turne..."
entries.dialogueText: I went to the living room and turned on the TV.
entries.menuText: Go straight to the living room and turn on the TV.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was right on time for the game to..."
entries.dialogueText: I was right on time for the game to start.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing me for president. At least my own football team still liked me.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired == true || (BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost == true && BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty == false))
entries.conditions: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false)) == false

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech thanking me for all I'd done during my term. At least my own football team still liked me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right before kickoff, all of the me..."
entries.dialogueText: Right before kickoff, all of the members of FC Anrica suddenly lay down on the field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The captain stood up and explained..."
entries.dialogueText: The captain stood up and explained that the President of Sordland had a substantial stake in the team. In protest of my despicable actions, he and his teammates would not be playing tonight.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Turn off the TV."
entries.dialogueText: Turn off the TV.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up the nearest paperweight..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the nearest paperweight and threw it at the screen. Broken glass flew everywhere.
entries.menuText: Throw a heavy paperweight at the TV.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing me for president. At least Anrica still liked me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing Lileas Graf for president.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't even watch a football ga..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't even watch a football game without being reminded of everything I'd done wrong.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And everyone I'd lost."
entries.dialogueText: And everyone I'd lost.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc and Deana..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc and Deana...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Poor Serge..."
entries.dialogueText: Poor Serge...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Where would it end?"
entries.dialogueText: Where would it end?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the game began, I found I couldn..."
entries.dialogueText: As the game began, I found I couldn't even pay attention to it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was too busy thinking about every..."
entries.dialogueText: I was too busy thinking about everything I had left to do.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My party had abandoned me."
entries.dialogueText: My party had abandoned me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My military had turned against me."
entries.dialogueText: My military had turned against me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Court wanted me removed from of..."
entries.dialogueText: The Court wanted me removed from office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And I'd signed part of my country o..."
entries.dialogueText: And I'd signed part of my country over to Rumburg...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And Rumburg was on our doorstep..."
entries.dialogueText: And Rumburg was on our doorstep...

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Won == true || BaseGame.Public_Opinion > 1 || BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_ExtendEmergency_Extend == true)
entries.conditions: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Won"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Public_Opinion"] > 1  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_ExtendEmergency_Extend"] == true) == false

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At least I was on track to win anot..."
entries.dialogueText: At least I was on track to win another term. But was that what I even wanted?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My chances of re-election were slim..."
entries.dialogueText: My chances of re-election were slim, to say the least. And was that what I even wanted?

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went up to my office and spun the..."
entries.dialogueText: I went up to my office and spun the globe on my desk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could go to Kyrute. It was the on..."
entries.dialogueText: I could go to Kyrute. It was the one completely neutral country I knew of, and a little house in the mountains wouldn't cost me much.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I smiled to myself. My entire life..."
entries.dialogueText: I smiled to myself. My entire life had built up to this presidency. I had to keep going.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "No, it wasn't. Admitting that to my..."
entries.dialogueText: No, it wasn't. Admitting that to myself felt like a heavy weight being lifted off my shoulders.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The end of my term suddenly felt ye..."
entries.dialogueText: The end of my term suddenly felt years away. If I stayed in Sordland, would I even make it to retirement?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "No matter what -- or who -- it woul..."
entries.dialogueText: No matter what -- or who -- it would cost me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went up to my office and began dr..."
entries.dialogueText: I went up to my office and began drafting a speech announcing my retirement from politics.
entries.menuText: Draft a speech announcing your retirement from politics.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gritted my teeth. I had come this..."
entries.dialogueText: I gritted my teeth. I had come this far. I would finish what I had started.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started packing my suitcase. I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: I started packing my suitcase. I wasn't going to stay in Sordland a second longer.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I decided to cover up my tracks jus..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to cover up my tracks just in case. There were some documents that needed to be incinerated.
entries.menuText: Leave after covering up your tracks just in case.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gritted my teeth. I would stick i..."
entries.dialogueText: I gritted my teeth. I would stick it out until the end of my term -- but no longer.
entries.menuText: Stick with your plan to retire.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was time for a fresh start."
entries.dialogueText: It was time for a fresh start.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My entire life had built up to this..."
entries.dialogueText: My entire life had built up to this presidency. Now, I couldn't wait for it to be over.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The end of my term suddenly felt ag..."
entries.dialogueText: The end of my term suddenly felt ages away. And if I continued in politics, the years after that would just be more of the same...

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I willed myself to stop overthinkin..."
entries.dialogueText: I willed myself to stop overthinking everything. I was tired.
entries.menuText: Stop contemplating and go to bed.
